headline: Cornell go through Ivy play unbeaten
dek: Cornell dropped points in Ivy play only in a draw at Yale, and have since beaten Harvard and Penn again. Across the season they have won 14 matches and lost three, each defeat to a side from outside the conference.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring in this conference runs through one programme: Cornell's 48 goals are more than Columbia, Dartmouth and Harvard scored between them.

wire.line: Cornell have not lost since Colgate beat them in October.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Marco Bottene has scored 11 of Penn's 32 goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Yale's 19 goals have come from fourteen different scorers.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Andrew Samuels has kept seven shutouts in Princeton's goal.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their date carry no result: a Dartmouth home match in August and a Cornell home match in October.

last_match.line: Cornell have won every home match that has a published result.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
